consumer_description: Calculates optimal review intervals, easiness factor (EF), and repetition decay based on user recall grade (0-5).

rea_evidence.decompiled_snippet: double calculate_factor(double factor, int grade) { double next = factor + (0.1 - (5 - grade) * (0.08 + (5 - grade) * 0.02)); return next < 1.3 ? 1.3 : next; }
limitations: Evaluates standard SM-2 algorithm without FSRS fuzzy adjustments

inputs.name: cardState
inputs.type: { repetitions: number; intervalDays: number; easeFactor: number }

outputs.name: nextState
outputs.type: { repetitions: number; intervalDays: number; easeFactor: number; nextDueDate: string }
